id: title:clr182:allow personal api key access to playlist recording endpoints

review.posthog_relevance: Adds permission enforcement and authorization tests for session recording playlist write operations, establishing the boundary between read and write access and validating the middleware's behavior.
review.reason: Adds a class attribute defining write actions and corresponding authorization tests, establishing the permission boundary and validating the middleware. This is a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual runtime behavior and complete implementation of the permission checks are not fully demonstrated, relying on supplied hunk observations; no broader systemic risk reduction or broader capability change is observed.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new class attribute listing write actions for session recording playlists.
observations.posthog_connection: Defines the set of actions requiring write permissions, establishing the boundary between read and write access for playlist resources.

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting that a personal API key with write scope can perform write operations.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that the authorization middleware correctly recognizes the write scope and allows the request.

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting that a personal API key with read-only scope is denied on write operations.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that the authorization middleware correctly denies requests lacking write permission, returning a forbidden status.
